title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
description: Anthropic filed a Form S-1 registration statement with the SEC for a proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. The filing is a major step toward the company becoming publicly traded.

title: The latest AI news we announced in October 2026
description: Google's October recap covers Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier reasoning model, and Gemini 4 Carbon, which is in limited pre-release testing with the U.S. government and cyber defenders. It also lists Genie 4, EmbeddingGemma 2, and the Project Suncatcher satellite returning an AI response generated in orbit.

title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
description: Anthropic broadened its agreement with the U.S. General Services Administration. Government partners get a 40% discount on Claude products.

title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
description: Anthropic scientists have begun deep research partnerships with six drug developers. The goal is to speed up the creation of new medicines using Claude.

title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
description: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program to include foundations and research bodies. It spotlights twenty partner organizations in the program.
